_note: Rempo's claim rules, copied from the landing page repository (RempoLandingPage meta/rules/copy-rules.json, which mirrors the go-to-market build's landing-page/copy-rules.json). Applied to every visitor-facing word in content/ by tools/copy-lint.mjs on each build and in npm test. refusalOk: the words may appear only in a sentence that refuses them (no, not, never, don't, won't...). allow: a content key (a prefix match) where a rule is waived, with the reason. budgets: word budgets; the hero-quiz variant's h1 and lead are errors over budget (the Meta page's rule), everything else a warning.

rules.msg: Never promise reviews: describe the asking, not the result
The 7-day guarantee is PLANNED; no guarantees of results
No lift claimed for the personalized request
Approval mode is unconfirmed: no 'instant', 'automatic' or 'autopilot'
Only as a refusal: Rempo does not remove reviews
Only as a refusal: no review gating
The Run 2 offer is PLANNED: no prices or terms on the page
Name no job software as supported until product confirms it

allow.reason: The ticket options are the owner's own job ticket, not Rempo's price (Deliverable 1, section 14: allow the ticket keys).
The invisible work dollar figure is the value of the owner's own finished work, not Rempo's price (Deliverable 1, section 14).
The call notes are for the team only, never shown to a visitor; the figures are the owner's own ticket band.
